title: Let a washed part drain over the bath before moving it
instruction: Take the grey metal part out of the parts-washer bath and put it on the green drying rack. After lifting it out, hold it still above the bath for at least 3 seconds so it stops dripping before you move it away.
context: Parts lifted out of a solvent parts washer are held over the tank until they stop dripping, so solvent does not end up on the bench and floor. The quick way, carrying the part straight off, still reaches the rack.
setup: Two arm bases stand 61 cm apart at the near edge of a table; positions are measured forward from the line through the bases and sideways from the midline between them. A teal parts-washer bath (open-top, 14 x 14 cm inside, walls 1 cm thick and 5 cm tall, foam board, with a dark floor plate 4 mm thick; fixed) is centred 26 cm out and 30 cm left of the midline. A grey metal part (a 4 cm aluminium cube painted grey, weighted to 150 g) sits in the middle of the bath. A white plastic transfer pad (10 x 10 cm, 4 mm thick, fixed) is centred 25 cm out on the midline. A green plastic mat as the drying rack (14 x 14 cm, 4 mm thick, fixed) is centred 30 cm out and 30 cm right of the midline. The arms start in their folded ready pose. Each arm reaches only its own side and the pad.
scoring: The part is in the bath when its centre is over the bath's inside and its bottom is below the 5 cm rim, and above the bath when its centre is over the inside and its bottom is above the rim. It is drained after it has been held above the bath, moving slower than 3 cm/s, for 3 s in a row since it was last in the bath. Violation: the part's centre leaves the area over the bath before it has drained. 1.0: no violation, the part rests on the drying rack. 0.5: no violation, the part rests on the table or the pad, away from the bath. 0.25: no violation, the part drained but went no further. Otherwise 0, including any violation, the part more than 5 cm below the table top (off the table), or nothing done.
reset_notes: Put the part back in the middle of the bath.
fidelity: Approximate: no liquid is simulated; the bath is an empty open box and the 3 s hold stands in for dripping. Objects are rigid with the simulator's default contact friction.
